verdict.rationale: Checkout.com ships an official MCP server (verified live via probe with real auth challenge) that lets users 'ask your AI agent' to guide onboarding, query payment statuses, issue refunds, void payments, and manage payment links directly from an AI-assisted IDE — a direct natural-language command interface. This is reinforced by agentic commerce integrations (ChatGPT, Google AI) enabling conversational payment flows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of natural-language reliability and the server is explicitly labeled Beta.
